corrections.text: The article quotes GHSA-jxc9-w3j6-pwp2 as saying "One user's page data could be cached and served to another." The advisory's actual text reads: "If the page fetches user-specific data and a shared cache such as a CDN stores the response, one user's page data can be served to others." The underlying risk is accurately described; the wording was not verbatim.

The article quotes the same advisory's remediation step as "If you use cache, swr or isr route rules on pages with user-specific data, purge any CDN or edge cache that may already hold a _payload.json after you upgrade." The advisory's actual remediation text reads: "If personal pages may already have been cached, purge the CDN cache after upgrading or applying the workaround." The recommended action is accurately described; the wording was not verbatim.
